en.headline: TDC expects more than 3,000 at Business of IP Asia Forum
en.dek: The two-day event at the Convention and Exhibition Centre on 19 and 20 November will focus on IP commercialisation and run alongside Entrepreneur Day with over 370 startups.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council expects more than 3,000 participants at its annual Business of IP Asia Forum on 19 and 20 November at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Associate executive director Silas Chu said nearly 100 speakers would discuss how intellectual property and innovation could build competitive advantages and attract capital. For the first time the forum includes a chapter on IP commercialisation aimed at helping enterprises manage their intellectual property more effectively, reflecting rising demand in artificial intelligence, life sciences and deep tech.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan and HKTDC executive director Sophia Chong are scheduled to officiate at the opening. The forum runs alongside the 18th Entrepreneur Day, which will feature more than 370 startups and innovation projects from 14 countries and regions for business matching.
The theme is “Powering Commercial Success Through IP and Innovation”. The council said the events support Hong Kong’s aim of becoming an international innovation and technology centre.

zh.headline: 貿發局預期亞洲知識產權營商論壇逾3000人參與
zh.dek: 兩日活動將於11月19及20日在灣仔會議展覽中心舉行，聚焦知識產權商業化，並與創業日同步，後者有逾370間初創企業。
body: 香港貿易發展局預期，第16屆亞洲知識產權營商論壇將有超過3000人參與，活動於11月19及20日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行。
貿發局副總裁朱耀昌表示，接近100位講者將探討如何透過知識產權及創新建立競爭優勢並吸引資本。論壇今年首次加入知識產權商業化專章，旨在協助企業更有效管理知識產權，因應人工智能、生命科學及深科技領域需求上升。
財政司司長陳茂波及貿發局總裁張淑芬將主持開幕。論壇與第18屆創業日同步舉行，後者展出來自14個國家及地區逾370間初創企業及創新項目，方便商務配對。
今年主題為「知識產權與創新驅動商業成功」。貿發局表示，活動有助香港發展成為國際創科中心。
